retained.interpretation_limits: Within each temporal bin, pooled scenes/windows are correlated and differ in dynamics; descriptive associations, not causal effects.32-frame windows at60Hz resolve1.875Hz bins and cannot measure slower cycles. Spatial sweeps are stationary mode interventions, not temporal dynamics. Relative errors near absent signal are ill-conditioned.
